title: Kuku (music) - Wikipedia
text: May 24, 2025 - Kuku is the title of a traditional piece of music from the West African nation of Guinea. According to Mamady Keita, its rhythm was played by women as they came back from fishing. Nowadays this music is played during parties.

title: Kuku dialect - Wikipedia
text: March 2, 2026 - The traditional folk songs of the Kuku people are Bula and Kore. The songs are sung and traditional drums and the horn are played as instruments. The dance include shuffling of feet and stumping for the Bula, and some form of rhythmic jumping for the Kore. Modern music is also common among the Kuku.
